records.label: References
records.definition: Source record cites target without transferring authority.

records.label: Contains
records.definition: Source is a controlled container of target.

records.label: Derived From
records.definition: Source was transformed or generated from target.

records.label: Supersedes
records.definition: Source replaces target as current authority.

records.label: Blocks
records.definition: Source prevents target readiness until disposition.

records.label: Depends On
records.definition: Source requires target at a declared readiness.

records.label: Evidence For
records.definition: Source supports a claim or decision in target.

records.label: Synchronized With
records.definition: Source and target require controlled propagation without equal authority.

records.label: Requires Review
records.definition: Source requires review represented by target.
